source.repro: Against `test_data/breakpoint/hs37d5.HG002-SequelII-CCS.sv.vcf.gz` with `@gmod/tabix`: build a whole-genome region set (every reference sequence, full length), warm the index once, then take the median of 7 runs of `bytesForRegions(regions)` against `Promise.all(regions.map(r => bytesForRegions([r])))`.
source.notes: The two scopes cost the same because `bytesForRegions` already resolves chunks per region internally — only the final merge-and-sum is shared, so splitting it moves no work. Warm the index before timing: an unwarmed first call put the per-region arm at 2.6x, which is the index parse, not the reduction.
